dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about these telepathic experiences you've been having with animals?

I used to understand their thoughts perfectly, but lately the connection has gone completely silent because of the weather. I've been taking different Peruvian herbs to try and fix it, but nothing seems to be helping. I'm just trying to get my health back to where it was eight months ago.
I see. Besides these telepathic changes, have you been hearing any other sounds or voices when no one else is around?

No, I don't hear anything else, it's just the silence from the animals that worries me. It feels like my internal reception is blocked, and I'm just looking for a way to restore that natural link I once had.
Have you noticed any unusual sights, or do you feel like anyone is trying to harm you or monitor your thoughts? Also, could you tell me more about the specific herbs you've been taking?

I haven't seen anything unusual and nobody is trying to harm me, I'm just focused on clearing this blockage. I've been using a blend of maca root, cat’s claw, and some other dried leaves from the health store where I work. I'm really just concerned about getting my communication back to normal.
How has your mood been lately, and have you been having any trouble with sleep or your appetite? Also, have you noticed any changes in your ability to concentrate at work?

My mood is mostly just frustrated because I can't seem to break through this silence, though I've been sleeping fine in my burlap. My appetite is normal, but it is hard to focus at the store when I'm constantly trying to reach out to the birds outside. It's like a part of my mind is perpetually searching for a signal that isn't there anymore.

Sleeping in burlap is an interesting choice—could you tell me what led you to do that? Also, has anyone in your family ever had similar experiences or unique connections?

No, I don't get any messages from the TV or the radio. My focus is entirely on the natural world and the way the atmosphere is currently blocking my ability to reach the animals. It’s a very specific kind of silence that I’m trying to navigate.

It sounds like these thoughts have been very central to your life for a long time. Based on your symptoms and the tests we've conducted, I have reached a conclusion.

DIAGNOSIS

I understand you’ve reached a conclusion, but I’m still feeling very disconnected and frustrated by this internal silence. Did any of those tests show why my body isn't responding to the herbs I've been taking? I just want to feel like myself again and regain that link with the world outside.

Most of my interests used to involve spending time outside and listening to the local wildlife. Now, I spend most of my free time trying different herb combinations to see if I can finally clear the interference.

It sounds like this has been your primary way of interacting with the world for quite some time. Have you ever been treated by a psychiatrist or taken medication for your mental health before?

I have never seen a psychiatrist or taken any medications for my mental health. I've always been healthy and never felt the need for that kind of help before this silence started. I’m just focused on finding a way to get my natural reception back to normal.
